A BlitzLLVM extension: gives the brightest value in nits that the display of the window can show as the system says it: the brightness of SDR white times the room above it. It is 0 where the display has no HDR, the system does not say, or there is no window yet. This is what [AutoHDRPeak](AutoHDRPeak) uses by default.
@returns The peak brightness in nits, or 0 if unknown.
